decision: GO as a bounded CPU lifetime filter only; zero additional GPU candidates approved
execution_owner: Root owns independent full rerun; author owns primary output. Critic did not duplicate full event-model execution.
independent_critic_actions: Read entire frozen tool, manifest, pinned lifetime checker and documentation; independently verified the three pinned input hashes.
Derived and independently enumerated the closed-form conditions over all320 configurations without invoking the event checker.
Reviewed isolated hazard witnesses, parent trace comparison and independent flat-K/parity oracle; checked bank16 aliases bank8 only in the abstract model.
Checked default command makes no external model calls, CUDA candidates, GPU jobs or speed ranking. Python -O fails closed rather than disabling assertions silently.
Checked selected wait2/four-bank/ci1 experiment is explicitly pre-existing, not claimed as the search's discovered optimum.
reasoning: For the bounded power-of-two bank counts, an eight-group stage resetting ci has bank reuse distance min(banks,8). Before decoding, the previous depth committed groups can remain live, so depth must be strictly smaller than that distance.
After committing ci+1 groups of the successor stage and waiting down to depth, no previous-stage group can remain iff ci+1>=depth. Earlier X release is unsafe.

The independent conditions can both fail. Setting release_ci7 isolates AF overwrite; replacing AF banks with8 isolates X release for the bounded depths0..7. Keeping both witnesses is stronger than recording only the first thrown assertion.
Segment-end wait0 and inherited release/progress protocol are assumptions; the wrapper does not validate arbitrary CUDA or arbitrary barrier protocols.
Eight and sixteen declared banks reference the same bank indices0..7 in this model, but their source allocations need not produce identical compiled code.

negative_control_scope.caveat: The two trace examples demonstrate comparison behavior on constructed model traces; they are not mutant CUDA-source executions or numerical validation.

required_interpretation: 139 survivors means modeled lifetime-safe schedules with device behavior unknown; it does not mean139 useful optimizations or139 compiled feasible kernels.

672 finite cases per surviving schedule are model coverage, not all possible routes or scheduling interleavings. Six initial sequences cover logical slot/generation values, but barrier phases themselves are not simulated.
The flat trace represents K order and NTT1 accumulator parity, not actual floating-point operands, first-write behavior or tensor numerical arithmetic.

The NVIDIA occupancy-header96-register limit is necessary register-admission evidence only. Actual physical registers, local memory, static shared memory, serialization and occupancy require exact compiled queries.
Logical AF counts cannot predict speed. No Lean theorem, surrogate validation, measured gain, automatic GPU search or formal whole-kernel correctness proof is claimed.
